title: docs(rest): name the 503 row and add the partial-judgement row in the released 2fc3fce CHANGELOG entry
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDwkEEJd65kqFZGFjQnzBQt)_

Refs #32826 (item 4, the changeset half; the docs half and items 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 land in #33491)

Area-lease pilot #33059 · area E2b · seat `domain:server#5` · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz4f7zEQZ2C9GTG382

## What changes

The released 18.4.0 entry `2fc3fce` in `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` (the dataset query door judges which refused holders the caller is admitted to), under "Moved for every caller":

1. "… one admitted to every holder included, **so the row above applies to it**" reached across a list boundary: it opens the "Moved for every caller" list, so "the row above" is the last row of the previous list, which a reader of this list does not see as above it. It now names the row it means: the holder "counts as a holder whose admission cannot be judged (the `503` row of the list above)".
2. A missing moved answer is added: where only some holders' own reads refuse, a caller admitted to every holder: `409` naming every holder → `409` naming only the holders that could be judged.

Docs-only. No code, no test, no changeset.

## Why

#32826 item 4 (contract review r2 N6 on PR #32804, 6836320789): the partial-judgement row was missing from the moved answers and the pointer was wrong. PR #32804's changeset has been consumed by the 18.4.0 release, so per AGENTS.md (RELEASE-OWNED, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`) the released entry is amended in a dedicated docs-only PR.

## Verification

- `git diff origin/main` — `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` only, +2 / −1.
